integrity: The generator and product representation are credited to earlier work. The present findings are the unique symmetric interval-coverage crossover and sharp asymptotic total-variation and Kolmogorov coefficients. Numerical calculations support but do not prove infinite-domain statements.
scientific_limitations: Only driftless, stationary one-dimensional Brownian diffusion with Poisson rate r>0 and fixed contraction 0<a<1. The exact crossing holds for every a; the optimal metric coefficients require a approaching one. No drift, random reset ratios, non-Poisson resets or nonstationary claims; independent validation remains unperformed.
title: Unique Gaussian-coverage crossover and sharp normal-approximation constants for partial-reset Brownian motion
